events.title: Even Day SF: Build for the Glasses of the Future with Even Realities
events.description:
https://luma.com/jvcxz1he

Even Realities makes smart glasses built to be worn all day. Even G2 looks like a normal pair of glasses but puts a display right in your line of sight. It has no camera, so it’s welcome in meetings, classrooms and conversations. We call our approach Quiet Tech: technology that’s there when you need it and gets out of the way when you don’t.

​Even Day is coming to San Francisco.

​If you’ve ever wanted to build for a screen that isn’t in your hand, this night is for you.

​Even G2 puts a display in your line of sight all day, with no camera and no phone in your hand. Developers have already shipped hundreds of apps to Even Hub. After Even Days around the globe, we’re bringing the night to SF for the builders, founders and tinkerers shaping what smart glasses become.

​What you’ll get

  • ​Hands-on time with G2. Demo stations run all night. Try the glasses, Terminal Mode and the best apps on Even Hub.

  • ​A fireside chat with Even Realities CEO Will Wang, moderated by Emily Chang. The Emmy Award–winning journalist and longtime Technology anchor sits down with Will to talk about where Even is headed, why glasses need third-party apps, and what AI means for the platform.

  • ​The developer deep dive. Our platform team walks through what’s new and what’s next for builders.

  • ​Direct access to the team behind the SDK. Bring your questions, your bug reports and your wildest feature requests.

  • ​The room. Developers, founders, and people from across SF tech and eyewear. Food and drinks are on us.

​Agenda

  • ​6:00 PM · Doors open. Food, drinks and G2 demos (all night)

  • ​7:00 PM · Welcome from Even Realities

  • ​7:15 PM · Fireside chat: Will Wang in conversation with Emily Chang

  • ​8:00 PM · Developer platform deep dive

  • ​8:30 PM · Demos and networking

  • ​9:00 PM · Doors close

​About Emily Chang
Emily Chang is an Emmy Award–winning journalist and bestselling author, and a leading voice on technology, business and culture. She hosts and executive-produces The Circuit with Emily Chang and Posthuman, where she meets the founders and innovators shaping what comes next. For more than a decade she anchored a daily technology news show, and her book Brotopia is a bestselling look inside Silicon Valley.

​Who should apply
Developers already building on Even Hub, and anyone who has thought “I’d build an app for glasses if…” That includes web devs, AI and agent builders, XR folks, hardware tinkerers and designers. We also welcome our friends in the eyewear industry and other smart glasses enthusiasts. You don’t need to own a G2.

​How to get in
Space is limited, so we’re asking you to answer a few questions. It takes about a minute. Approved guests get a confirmation and the venue details by October 29.
